svg.title: The world's tallest skyline of people stands over Asia — spike height is metropolitan population
svg.desc: Spike map of the world's largest urban agglomerations. A vertical spike is planted at each city; its height is proportional to the metropolitan population (2024 order of magnitude, United Nations World Urbanization Prospects). Hover or focus a spike to read its city and population; its neighbours dim so the skyline is explorable. The tallest spikes cluster over East and South Asia — Tokyo (37 million), Delhi (34 million) and Shanghai (30 million) — while the Americas, Africa and Europe carry shorter, sparser spikes.
svg.text: The century’s tallest skyline is made of people
Spike height = metropolitan population · the megacity belt runs through East and South Asia, from Tokyo to Delhi to Dhaka
One spike per urban agglomeration · height ∝ metropolitan population (2024, UN World Urbanization Prospects order of magnitude) · Equal Earth projection
